offering_description.value: Vertically integrated cannabis operator that cultivates, processes and sells cannabis products. It sells to consumers and patients through its own dispensaries and to other retailers on a wholesale basis, in the US and Europe.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vape cartridges; edibles; concentrates; topicals

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use recreational consumers and medical cannabis patients; B2B: wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold at retail dispensaries and wholesale to licensed retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: cultivates and processes cannabis into branded products, sold to retailers and consumers; retailer: operates licensed dispensaries selling to consumers and patients; brand owner: owns cannabis product brands sold in own and third-party stores

geography_served.value: global: Many US states with licensed operations, plus Europe (Germany, UK, Poland, Switzerland)

specialization.value: related lines: cultivation, product manufacturing, wholesale and retail dispensaries of cannabis

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned licensed dispensaries; distributors / dealers: wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries; online: online ordering with pickup and delivery

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis licensing and regulation, federal illegality in US, European medical cannabis rules

notes: Exact current state footprint and European operations may have changed.
